Method of Attack: Scans Shodan for IPs of vulnerable Memcached servers and launches DDoS attacks against desired targets by exploiting unsecured Memcached servers
Discoverer: infosec researcher behind the Spuz.me blog
Attack Vector: Unsecured Memcached servers with exposed UDP port 11211
Indicators of Compromise: List of over 17,000 IP addresses belonging to vulnerable Memcached servers
